episodes.title: Fame
episodes.summary: Ben's secret is out. As Ben deals with his newfound fame, a new threat emerges as a thief steals parts of a new advanced spaceship from NASA.

episodes.title: Duped
episodes.summary: Ben is supposed to attend a tournament to support his girlfriend, but the Forever Knights are trying to break into a museum. Ben tries to use the Ultimatrix to handle all his obligations.

episodes.title: Hit 'Em Where They Live
episodes.summary: With Ben's identity known, some of his enemies (such as Zombozo, Rojo, Charmcaster, Vulkanus, and SevenSeven) team up to try to attack his family. Now Ben and friends have to protect them no matter what.

episodes.title: Video Games
episodes.summary: Ben gets an offer to star in his own video game, but the designer's real motives are part of a plan to destroy Ben.

episodes.title: Escape from Aggregor
episodes.summary: The team encounters another alien who escaped from Aggregor and, through him, learns more about Aggregor's goals.

episodes.title: Too Hot to Handle
episodes.summary: P'Andor, escaped from Aggregor, now wants help to escape his encapsulating suit, but Kevin's the first to perceive that that's a fatally bad idea.

episodes.title: Andreas' Fault
episodes.summary: Then team encounters another of Aggregor's escaped prisoners, Andreas, whom Argit is using as part of a scheme against the Forever Knights.

episodes.title: Fused
episodes.summary: Ra'ad, the last of Aggregor's escaped prisoners, attacks Ben and informs the team of the true fate of his comrades. He finds a safe hiding place but one that endangers Ben in the process.

episodes.title: Hero Time
episodes.summary: Ben meets his hero, Captain Nemesis, who's become jealous of all the attention Ben attracts.

episodes.title: Ultimate Aggregor
episodes.summary: Aggregor has all five aliens. The Plumbers manage to disable Aggregor's ship, forcing Aggregor to find a new way to absorb their powers. The team makes a last ditch effort to save the alien prisoners.

episodes.title: Map of Infinity
episodes.summary: Aggregor has absorbed all the powers of his captured aliens. Now he's after the Map of Infinity.

episodes.title: Reflected Glory
episodes.summary: Cash and JT convince the team to allow them to take credit for the team's actions so they can earn money for Cash's mother's operation.

episodes.title: Deep
episodes.summary: Ben, Gwen, and Kevin travel to the center of a water planet, namely Pisces, Ripjaws' home planet in an attempt to find Aggregor. They end up getting help from Magister Pyke, one of Ripjaws' species. The planet has a 2% solid core, which holds an instrument that holds the planet's water together in a gravitational pull. Aggregor takes the instrument and reveals it to be a piece of The Map of Infinity. As the planet is pulling apart, Aggregor escapes. Ben transforms into Goop and uses Goop's anti-gravitational UFO in an attempt to fix the centripetal force holding the planet together. Goop vanishes, and Kevin says he was atomized and spread throughout the ocean. The water then turns green, and Goop pulls the planet back together.

episodes.title: Where the Magic Happens
episodes.summary: Gwen, Ben, and Kevin follow Aggregor into a mystical dimension called Legerdomain with the help of Charmcaster, who was born there. They believe Aggregor's target to be the Alpha Rune worn around Addwaitya's neck, which they suspect is a disguised piece of the Map of Infinity. Gwen and Charmcaster work together several times, and the two develop a bond that seems to lead to Charmcaster changing her ways. While the group tries to steal the Alpha Rune, Aggregor uses the distraction to knock Addwaitya out and take it himself. Gwen, Ben, and Kevin escape Legerdomain with Charmcaster's help, but Charmcaster remains behind to free Legerdomain from Addwaitya's rule. Ben promises Gwen that they'll find a way to return and help Charmcaster after Aggregor is defeated.

episodes.title: Perplexhahedron
episodes.summary: With the fourth piece of the Map of Infinity almost in Aggregor's clutches, the gang chase him through the artificial planetoid known as Perplexahedron.

episodes.title: The Forge of Creation
episodes.summary: As the team makes its final attempt to stop Aggregor, they find an unexpected ally, and one person will make a fateful decision with lasting repercussions.

episodes.title: Nor Iron Bars a Cage
episodes.summary: With Kevin having absorbed Ben's aliens and become insane once again, Ben and Gwen have to go to the null void prison in an attempt to stop Kevin from destroying all the people there. We learn more about how Kevin got his material absorbing powers. In the end Ben thinks Kevin should be put down.

episodes.title: The Enemy of My Enemy
episodes.summary: Argit asks Ben and Gwen for protection from Kevin, so they take him to the nearest Plumbers Academy, but that won't stop Kevin.

episodes.title: Absolute Power (1)
episodes.summary: Kevin starts going after Plumbers kids to gain more power. Ben and Gwen continue to argue about how to handle the situation. Gwen tries to find someone who will help her cure Kevin.

episodes.title: Absolute Power (2)
episodes.summary: Final confrontation with Kevin. While Gwen makes a last ditch effort to save Kevin, Ben fights an all out battle with Kevin.

episodes.title: The Transmogrification of Eunice
episodes.summary: The team's camping break is interrupted when a pod crashes nearby. The occupant has no memory who she is or where she came from. Sunder soon arrives to retrieve her.

episodes.title: Eye of the Beholder
episodes.summary: Ship runs away to help Baz-El. Julie turns to Ben for help, but after their break up, he's reluctant. Gwen and Kevin accompany Julie on her quest.

episodes.title: Viktor: The Spoils
episodes.summary: The King of Zarkovia asks the team for help with a civil war. The team agrees to help when they find out Dr. Viktor may be involved.

episodes.title: The Big Story
episodes.summary: Jimmy investigates a possible alien sighting. But with no solid evidence, few believe him. As Ben starts acting strangely, the others suspect Jimmy may be right.

episodes.title: Girl Trouble
episodes.summary: Cousin Sunny is supposed to stay with Gwen for the summer. The team learns why her parents sent their child to Gwen when she helps them stop a robot invasion.

episodes.title: Revenge of the Swarm
episodes.summary: Ben is attacked by Victor Validus. The team soon discovers that Validus passed away. The team turns to Ben's friend, Elena, for help to locate the Nanite Queen.

episodes.title: The Creature from Beyond
episodes.summary: The Forever Knights open an ancient vault hoping to find weapons. They unwittingly release a creature.

episodes.title: Basic Training
episodes.summary: Ben, Gwen, and Kevin are summoned to a Plumbers' Academy to go under training that is supervised by Magister Hulka.

episodes.title: It's Not Easy Being Gwen
episodes.summary: Gwen has always been a multi-tasker, trying to juggle school, hobbies, friends and her work as a hero, waking up early and going to sleep late. But Gwen's already packed day is about to get worse when Dr. Animo attacks with an army of giant frogs and Gwen is forced to make a hard choice.

episodes.title: Ben 10,000 Returns
episodes.summary: 20 years in the future, Eon attacks Ben 10,000, then disappears. Adult Ben travels back in time fearing Eon will attack his younger self, the present day Ben.

episodes.title: Moon Struck
episodes.summary: Grandpa Max tells the team about his first UFO encounter, which led him to meet Verdona.

episodes.title: Prisoner #775 is Missing
episodes.summary: After a base is attacked, Max is infuriated when they learn it was a secret alien prison facility. While Max argues with the officer in charge, the team tries to locate an escaped prisoner.

episodes.title: The Purge
episodes.summary: Old George, the original Forever Knight, reclaims his position, and orders the Knights to remove all aliens on Earth.

episodes.title: Simian Says
episodes.summary: Simian asks the team for help when a DNAlien takes over his home world.

episodes.title: Greetings from Techadon
episodes.summary: Ben faces Tecadon killer robots that have been programmed to kill him. Each robot is more powerful than the last one. Ben's only chance to survive is for Gwen to find out who commissioned the robots.

episodes.title: The Flame Keeper's Circle
episodes.summary: Julie gets Ben to visit a charity organization who wants to improve the world with alien technology. Ben soon discovers the charity's benefactor is an old enemy.

episodes.title: Double or Nothing
episodes.summary: Ben finds out there's a new show called 'Ben 10: Live." He finds an old enemy running the show and cashing in on his fame.

episodes.title: The Perfect Girlfriend
episodes.summary: Julie suddenly leaves a tennis tournament and spends all her time with Ben.

episodes.title: Ultimate Sacrifice
episodes.summary: Ben's Ultimate transformations have developed their own personalities. Now they want their freedom from Ben.

episodes.title: The Widening Gyre
episodes.summary: Colonel Rozum asks the team to investigate an island of garbage where people have been disappearing.

episodes.title: The Mother of All Vreedles
episodes.summary: Ma Vreedle goes to Earth to expand her family by creating clones and using all the water on Earth.

episodes.title: A Knight to Remember
episodes.summary: The Flame Keepers realize their mistake too late. Vilgax wants the power of Daigon. The Forever Knights are out to destroy Daigon. Ben and the team try to sort things out.

episodes.title: Solitary Alignment
episodes.summary: Azmuth reveals the origin of the sword and how he first encountered Old George. Ben comes to a decision on how to handle the Daigon.

episodes.title: Inspector #13
episodes.summary: A Techadon weapon master comes to Earth and wants the Ultimatrix.

episodes.title: The Enemy of My Frenemy
episodes.summary: Gwenand the gang revisit Legerdomain in hopes of rescuing Charmcaster.

episodes.title: Couples Retreat
episodes.summary: Charmcaster and Darkstar team up to destroy Ben, Gwen and Kevin.

episodes.title: Catch a Falling Star
episodes.summary: Movie starlet Jennifer Nocturne is recaptured by the evil Captain Nemesis!

episodes.title: The Eggman Cometh
episodes.summary: Dr. Animo returns with a plot to transform eggs into pterodactyls.

episodes.title: Night of the Living Nightmare
episodes.summary: Albedo attempts to get even with Ben, by trapping him in a dream version of Bellwood, and dispatching an assortment of villains, as well as versions of Gwen and Kevin desiring the Ultimatrix, to attempt to defeat him.

episodes.title: The Beginning of the End
episodes.summary: The final battle between the Forever Knights and Dagon's Esoterica is in full swing, with Ben caught in the middle.

episodes.title: The Ultimate Enemy (1)
episodes.summary: Ben, Gwen, Kevin, and George trash Diagon's City while battling a reborn, Lucubra-morphed, power hungry Vilgax. Diagon is released and plans to become ruler of Ben's Universe.

episodes.title: The Ultimate Enemy (2)
episodes.summary: After defeating Vilgax, Ben battles Dagon in his True Form as Ultimate Way Big.
